tr-1885-buckskin.description: Theodore Roosevelt in 1885 — 1 photographic print. | Photograph showing full-length portrait of Theodore Roosevelt, seated, in deer skin hunting suit, holding rifle] — Creator: Bain, George Grantham — Date: 1885
tr-1885-buckskin.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-1885-buckskin.credit_line: Theodore Roosevelt in 1885, in the buckskin suit made for him in Dakota. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

tr-rough-rider-uniform.description: [Theodore Roosevelt in Rough Riders uniform] - Title from item. Created/published c1900 August 1.
tr-rough-rider-uniform.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-rough-rider-uniform.credit_line: Theodore Roosevelt in the uniform of the 1st United States Volunteer Cavalry. Studio portrait copyright 1900 by Rockwood, New York - two years after Cuba, cropped from the press-file mount. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

gun-bearers.description: [Roosevelt's and Kermit's, four gun bearers] - LOC summary: Photograph showing four African men standing with guns. Kermit Roosevelt is standing in the background. Theodore Roosevelt doesn't appear in the picture. Created/published c1910 Apr.
gun-bearers.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
gun-bearers.credit_line: Roosevelt's and Kermit's four gun-bearers, British East Africa, 1910; the Library of Congress record notes that the figure at the back is Kermit Roosevelt and that Theodore Roosevelt is not in the picture - cropped from the album mount. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

tr-saddle-ride-1903.description: At home in the saddle - Pres. Roosevelt on a 60 mile ride, Laramie to Cheyenne, Wyo.
tr-saddle-ride-1903.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-saddle-ride-1903.credit_line: President Roosevelt on a sixty-mile ride, 1903 - left frame cropped from a stereograph card. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

sagamore-exterior.description: [Exterior view of Sagamore Hill house, Theodore Roosevelt's summer home]
sagamore-exterior.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
sagamore-exterior.credit_line: Sagamore Hill, about 1905 - cropped from the album mount. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

tr-caravan-1909.description: T. R. and some members of his caravan - Title from item. H127198 U.S. Copyright Office. Created/published c 1909 Jun. 11.
tr-caravan-1909.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-caravan-1909.credit_line: T. R. and some members of his caravan, British East Africa, 11 June 1909 - cropped from the grey album mount. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-caravan-1909.note: Fetched in the 2026 audit so that the two African-kit questions in Guns and Gear stop borrowing the 1898 Rough Rider studio portrait. Roosevelt is in the field rig the questions describe: sun helmet, khaki jacket, khaki trousers buttoned below the knee, hobnailed boots. The record names none of the porters, so the caption names none.
